---
title: "If you are funded via grants, what type of grants are they?"
question_id: fund3qnl_0
---

```{r}
#| include: false
#| file: ../R/_load_common.R
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
recode_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~raw, ~clean,
  # Multiple/combined funding
  "(?i)all of the above|\\berc and horizon\\b|nwo\\s*\\+\\s*groeifonds", "Multiple grants",

  # Open Science NL / Council (catch combined with NWO too)
  "(?i)open\\s*science\\s*(nl|council)|nwo\\s*/\\s*open\\s*science\\s*council", "Open Science NL / Council",

  # Horizon Europe (incl. misspelling)
  "(?i)horizon\\s*europe(n)?\\b", "Horizon Europe",

  # ERC
  "(?i)\\berc\\b", "ERC",

  # ZonMw
  "(?i)\\bzon\\s*mw\\b|\\bzonmw\\b", "ZonMw",

  # NWO (incl. vidi and references without Open Science)
  "(?i)\\bnwo\\b|\\bvidi\\b", "NWO",

  # UKRI
  "(?i)\\bukri\\b", "UKRI",

  # EU (unspecified)
  "(?i)^eu$", "EU (unspecified)",

  # Internal university grants
  "(?i)internal\\s+university\\s+grant", "Internal university grant",

  # Thematic (incl. Thematic DCC)
  "(?i)^thematic(\\s+dcc)?$", "Thematic",

  # LSRI
  "(?i)\\blsri\\b", "LSRI",

  # Bioimaging
  "(?i)bioimaging", "Bioimaging"
)

data_coded <- process_text_codes_with_allocation(
  filter = "Netherlands",
  question_code = "fund3qnl_0",
  recode_map = recode_map,
  header = "Grant (Netherlands)",
  other = FALSE,
  cache_id = "fund3qnl_0"
)

data_coded$summary_table
```

The raw-to-category allocation table for this question is in @sec-appendix-recoding.
